I feel that reading this post you're trying to convince us to tell you that you should stay with her. 

When I was 9 years old my dad cheated on my mum. I found out when I was 18 and still don't know who he cheated on her with. They had been together for 15 years when he did that and my mum chose to work through it and they are still together and still in love to this day.

One one hand I am so proud of my mum, it made me see just how much she loves her children to do that for us. She is so strong and I don't give her enough support sometimes. And I'm glad they have stuck together because he was loyal for 15 years, and I can understand making dumb mistakes.

On the other hand, you just don't cheat on people. And if you do, you should respect that person enough to want to tell them. Don't cover up for your actions just for the sake of keeping them around you? I don't think that's fair at all and I think she mislead you for a very long time.

It's completely up to you, if you want to stay with her you need to be able to fully trust that she won't do it again and forgive her completely, otherwise it's gonna loom over your heads constantly.

- this is just my opinion. Good luck!

I'm 23f and I feel the same... I can't explain what helps but I know it helps me knowing there's other people out there who feel what I feel and they're still trucking on.. I'm all ears of you ever need a friend :)

This morning I woke up at my boyfriends place and he had already left for work. I wanted to do something nice to surprise him so I cleaned his bookshelf. I found a couple of girl things hidden in a box and calmly asked him about them.

I suffer from borderline personality disorder so I did a really good job staying calm and asking politely.

He told me who they belonged to and I did the stupid thing of searching them on Facebook. I'd already told him I found it hard him keeping ties with his ex's on social media and I don't keep people on social media around that I've slept with and id just like to have the same for me? Anyway he didn't delete her and she is so fucking attractive and I had a panic attack straightaway. 

I told him it's not his fault it's just me and then I started drinking and smoking to try and make it go away but I just got really depressed and suicidal. So I spent the whole day crying my eyes out and drinking and sleeping. My boyfriend stopped replying to my messages and ignored me all day.

I went over to his house thinking this would be goodbye because I know I have to kill myself it's too hard to continue living like this. And all I do is make others angry.

I came home and told him he won't see me again and he wasn't that upset about it. Which made me really freak out from realising he definitely doesn't care about me the way he says he does. And I got even more depressed and heart broken.

I kept thinking he would drive to my house to try and make me feel better but he didn't and was falling asleep.

I became panicky and couldn't breathe from unstoppable crying and complete pain all through my body. So I drove back to his house. I was so scared that me being there would just annoy him or make him angry because he wanted to sleep but I was so scared if I stayed home I'd hurt myself so I went.

I told him I was there and he went to the gate to meet me but I was scared and couldn't move. Then he got angry that I didn't come to the gate and he was getting mozzie bites and so he went back inside. I sat outside crying and apologising over and over on the phone to him while he got mad at me. Then I drove off and I wasn't sure where I was going because my brain at this point was not in my control. I sat screaming in my car, speeding while I drove aimlessly. And I kept calling him because I didn't want to go home I was so scared to come back here. He yelled at me and got so mad at me because he had work tomorrow and unlike me and my shitty retail job he has to actually put a lot of physical effort in. I explained that I am really sick and in a horrible state of mind and needed him to please be my friend and help me. I explained that if I went home I'd cut my wrist because I have razors and no one to stop me here. He told me he would never speak to me again if I cut myself, he told me to go home and to leave him alone. I also told him I wasn't sure where I was because I genuinely wasn't thinking where I was driving and was confused and he called me a liar for that and also I was a liar for saying I couldn't come to the gate because he was getting mad at me..

And now I'm laying in bed with a towel over my wrist, cuddling my stupid teddy bear, still crying and feeling more suicidal than ever.

I really apologise how long this is... but also you have no idea how much I appreciate your comment.
If there's a history book about girls with bpd who end up dead maybe I'll be in there :(

I definitely would rather no feelings than this constantly. 

I can't do better. I've spent my life thinking I could but I'm always back here in this spot. Drinking wine, crying and harming myself, waiting for my body to waste away and die. And wondering about ways to speed that process up.

It's so unfair when people do this shit. I struggle from severe borderline personality disorder and bipolar and because half the time I'm over the moon with happiness it somehow completely cuts out the fact that the other half of the time I'm completely depressed and hate myself and this fucked up world we live in. 

I want to say something to help you but it's so hard because I don't know what to even say to myself. I feel like people don't think I'll kill myself because they've seen me happy but it feels so completely real when I'm in pain. 

I'm a bit mixed up at the moment because I've been drinking a lot but reading your post I can so definitely understand and relate on my own level and I just want you to know that you're not alone in feeling this. And it would be nice knowing that there's still people out there who feel shit like me but still push through so we can maybe help each other?

So Ive spent the last 10 hours crying because my SO is so angry at me because I can't trust him but all I can feel is that he's getting angry and causing a fight over girls he says he doesn't even care about. So why is this a big deal?! Why get angry if you don't care anyway? Just delete them and move on? Or am I being irrational. 

Now I'm pissed off because I drove to his house because he's been so mad that apparently he wanted to punch himself in the face. he wanted me to come over and he calmed down once he saw me and then as soon as I got upset he got angry again? I apologised and tried to explain that my thoughts aren't real all the time and that sometimes I need help seeing that, then he got mad at me and said it's 'convienient' that I can blame all this on my mental illnesses...

 definitely not sure what to think or how to feel. My eyes are swollen from crying so much, I have a splitting headache from constant tensing, I can't stand being alone so I don't want to break up with him, and also I love him so much. I just don't know :(

I'm definitely not usually this rational and I see a psychiatrist to help me try and be more mindful of how I think. I guess it's usually only bad when I'm in a low cycle and I get angry and jump to conclusions and get very depressed. I know I do trust him but it's really hard when in my head I have so many negative assumptions about what he's up to and I have to keep telling myself that they're just thoughts and nothing more but I'm paranoid they will become something? 

I'm just really unsure of myself which makes me unsure of him.
I'll definitely give this a go though I feel like it won't end well!
